name: Louisiana

windshield.strip: transparent material, not red or amber, on the topmost portion, not more than 5 inches down from the top
windshield.reflective: max 20% luminous reflectance (all sun screening devices)

frontSide.note: 25% all tolerances included, since August 1, 2025 (Act 143 of 2025, HB 119); was 40% before

windshield.strip: transparent material, not red or amber, on the topmost portion, not more than 5 inches down from the top
windshield.reflective: max 20% luminous reflectance (all sun screening devices)

backSide.note: light transmittance requirement does not apply to windows behind the driver on trucks, buses, trailers, motor homes and multipurpose passenger vehicles (R.S. 32:361.1(D)(4)); 20% reflectance cap still applies

rear.note: same exclusion as rear side windows

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('light transmission' includes any glazing material)
tint.certificateOrSticker: Installer label (max 1.5 sq in, installer name and city) between film and glass, lower right corner of driver's side window (R.S. 32:361.1(D)(2)-(3)); manufacturers certify film to the Office of Motor Vehicles. Pre-1994 tint needs a certificate kept in the vehicle.

medicalExemption.text: Affidavit (form prepared by the Office of State Police) signed by a Louisiana-licensed optometrist or physician (incl. ophthalmologist, dermatologist) citing an ICD-9-CM recognized condition; notarized medical-records release; criminal-history check with fingerprints (violent crime or drug convictions disqualify); review every 3 years (porphyria: duration of ownership); decal displayed; does not cover windshield below top 6 inches except porphyria. A separate security exemption exists (R.S. 32:361.3).

penalty.text: Operator: fine up to $150 first offense, $250 second, $350 third or subsequent. Seller/installer/manufacturer/distributor: $1,000 first, $2,000 second, business ban on third.

tint.lastAmended: 2025 (Acts 2025, No. 143, effective August 1, 2025); also Acts 2024, No. 268 (Wildlife and Fisheries enforcement vehicles exempt)
quotes: A sun screening device when used in conjunction with automotive safety glazing materials on the front side window, with a light transmission of at least twenty-five percent, all tolerances included

side window behind the driver with a light transmission of at least twenty-five percent, all tolerances included, and rearmost windows with a light transmission of at least twelve percent, all tolerances included.
All sun screening devices shall not have a luminous reflectance of more than twenty percent.
A transparent material, not red or amber in color, affixed to the topmost portion of the windshield not to extend more than five inches down from the top.

helmet.conditions: All operators and riders of motorcycles, motor-driven cycles and motorized bicycles; fine $50

handheldPhone.fineText: $100 (secondary offense) outside school/highway construction zones; $250 and primary offense in school or construction zones; doubled if crash; warnings only before January 1, 2026

studdedTires.cite: La. R.S. 32:362(B) (no protuberances other than rubber except farm machinery and tire chains)

radarDetector.note: No state ban on radar detectors in private passenger vehicles found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

underglow.rule: No red or green light visible from directly in front; flashing lights prohibited except emergency vehicles, school buses, turn/hazard signals; neon or other lights around license plates prohibited
